sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Mannequin Head - Jumping Challenge is the simple yet addictive gameplay mechanic of controlling a mannequin head as it bounces and jumps through levels. The game is played using the mouse or keyboard, with the goal of navigating the head through increasingly difficult terrain without falling off a ledge or getting crushed.

"The controls are simple, with the mouse or keyboard used to move the head left and right, and the jump button used to propel the head upward.
